serp_refs: Marketplace scan: koi rugs are commonly positioned with koi pond, Japanese garden, lotus, lily pad, irregular shape and meditation room language.
Marketplace scan: classroom mats are searched with personalized teacher name, classroom door, composition notebook, back to school and grade-level welcome wording.
Marketplace scan: chibi and subject-specific teacher mats use cute school icons, music, speech therapy and colorful classroom decor modifiers.
keyword_evidence: Use visual-specific long tails: koi pond shaped rug, Japanese koi fish area rug, lotus koi rug, meditation room koi rug, personalized classroom welcome mat, teacher name classroom mat, chibi classroom mat and music teacher doormat.
buyer_summary: B052 buyers split between calm nature decor shoppers choosing koi pond shaped rugs and teachers preparing a personalized classroom entrance. They care about artwork clarity, irregular rug shape, non slip backing, size options, washable/easy-clean surface and readable custom names.
purchase_concerns: Do not imply the koi rugs are actual raised ponds; describe printed/shaped pond artwork. Avoid repeating identical classroom copy: separate composition notebook, chibi 2nd grade, Mrs. Brown classroom, Mrs. Smith pencil/grid and Mrs. Aisha music piano motifs.
